name: Lista USD
oneLiner: LISUSD is Lista DAO's overcollateralized stablecoin on BNB Chain, minted from BNB and LST vaults with a PSM enabling 1:1 swaps against USDT, USDC, and FDUSD.
collateral: BNB, ETH, and LSTs via CDPs; USDT/USDC/FDUSD via Peg Stability Module
pegMechanism: PSM enabling 1:1 swaps with centralized stablecoins; CDP overcollateralization and liquidation

mintAuthority.summary: LISUSD uses a Maker-style wards() auth pattern; wards(timelock) = 1 confirmed. Timelock (24h delay) owns proxy admin and is the only confirmed ward. Minter ward set could not be enumerated from pruned BSC history; active mint wards besides the timelock remain unconfirmed.

mintIncidents.summary: After the Ankr aBNBc infinite-mint exploit crashed the collateral's market price, an attacker borrowed about 16.4M HAY (now lisUSD) against near-worthless aBNBc because Helio's oracle still priced it at the Chainlink BNB feed, leaving roughly 19M HAY of bad debt through the issuance route.

sources.label: CoinDesk — Helio attacker nets $15M after Ankr exploit

controls.label: LISUSD MINTER ward (actual minter addresses unconfirmed)
controls.capDescription: LISUSD uses wards() Maker-style auth; mint() reverts with 'LisUSD/not-authorized-minter' unless caller is a ward. Specific minter contract addresses could not be enumerated from pruned BSC history.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103622030: mint(timelock, 1) revert message = 'LisUSD/not-authorized-minter' confirms custom wards-based guard (not OpenZeppelin AccessControl). wards() mapping is Maker-style (storage slot 0 = 1). No mint Transfer events from address(0) found in last 49K blocks; BSC publicnode history pruned beyond that. Minter ward addresses could not be enumerated via Rely/Deny event scan due to pruning.

controls.label: LISUSD admin timelock (24h delay, ward confirmed)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103622030: eth_getCode = CONTRACT (len=14880). getMinDelay() = 86400 (24h). wards(this_address) on LISUSD = 1 (confirmed ward). Sourcify source labels DEFAULT_ADMIN as TimeLock and onlyAdmin gates rely()/deny() calls. Proxy admin (0x1fa3e471...) owner() = this timelock address.

controls.label: LISUSD EIP-1967 proxy admin (owned by timelock)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103622030: EIP-1967 admin slot on LISUSD proxy = 0x1fa3e4718168077975ff4039304cc2e19ae58c4c. eth_getCode = CONTRACT (len=3764). owner() = 0x07D274a68393E8b8a2CCf19A2ce4Ba3518735253 (timelock). Can upgrade LISUSD implementation.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103622030: LISUSD (0x0782b6d8...) is an EIP-1967 proxy; impl = 0xf5bd9b192092517d60e90c9af17b69b134c4d7f8; proxy admin = 0x1fa3e471... (owned by timelock). wards(timelock=0x07D274...) = 1. Custom Maker-style auth confirmed (mint reverts 'LisUSD/not-authorized-minter' for non-wards). Timelock getMinDelay() = 86400s (24h). Minter ward set (CDP/PSM join contracts) could not be enumerated — publicnode prunes BSC logs beyond last 50K blocks and Relay events were not emitted in that window.
